what.text: Internal displacement was recorded in Syria, while other people fled as refugees and asylum seekers.
Internal displacement associated with conflict was 433000 in 2009 and reached 7600000 in 2014.
By 2025, UNHCR reported 4865764 refugees from Syria.

why.text: Conflict episodes included fighting between the Government of Syria and Syrian insurgents, PYD, IS, and SDF.
Another conflict episode involved the Government of Israel and the Government of Syria in 2025.
Disaster events were also recorded, including 702205 new disaster movements in 2023.

when.text: IDMC recorded 156000 new conflict displacements in 2011, which reached 3500000 in 2013.
In 2025, 531246 new conflict displacements were recorded, and 1341148 returns occurred in the same year.
The number of refugees stood at 6848865 in 2021 and was 4865764 in 2025.

how.text: UNHCR counts internally displaced people inside Syria whom it protects or assists.
IDMC tracks internal displacement associated with conflict and disaster events separately.
The sources don't say where displaced people live or how they traveled.
